text: Unitree Robotics closed at 845 yuan in its Shanghai debut, over 460% above its offer price after rising nearly 630% intraday. The humanoid and quadruped robot maker raised about 6.1 billion yuan in its IPO, with DeepSeek among participating investors.

meta.note: First-day pricing limits separation of durable valuation structure from listing-specific demand.

text: Target's Q2 net sales rose 5.3% and comparable sales 3.8%, with all six major categories growing. Net earnings included a $752 million tariff refund. Digital comparable sales rose 8.7%, while apparel and home lagged other categories.

meta.note: The tariff refund separates reported earnings from the quarter's underlying operating result.

text: Merck and Moderna's personalized mRNA vaccine with Keytruda met the primary Phase 3 endpoint in over 1,100 melanoma patients, extending recurrence-free survival versus Keytruda alone. Distant metastasis risk was also reduced; overall survival remains under assessment.

meta.note: Regulatory submission timing and overall-survival data remain unspecified.

text: Treasury will at least double maximum buybacks from $2 billion to $4 billion in 10- to 30-year debt from Sept. 9 through Nov. 4. After the announcement, the 10-year yield fell 6 basis points to 4.647% and the 30-year fell 9 basis points to 5.196%.

meta.note: Buybacks alter outstanding maturity distribution rather than reduce total government debt.

text: The 30-year Treasury yield fell over 9 basis points to 5.196% and the 10-year fell over 5 basis points to 4.647% after Treasury doubled long-duration debt repurchases. The 30-year had exceeded 5.33% Tuesday, its highest level since June 2007.

meta.note: This entry overlaps directly with the 12:30pm buyback event but isolates the yield-state reversal.

text: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar told employees the company will be public in 2027, with an earlier debut conditional on business performance. OpenAI confidentially filed its IPO prospectus in June. Its annualized revenue run rate exceeds $40 billion.

meta.note: The exact IPO date remains unspecified, with 2027 stated as the outer timing boundary.

text: Total U.S. government debt reached $40.05 trillion, up from $19.4 trillion a decade earlier. The July deficit was $432.3 billion and the fiscal-year shortfall approached $1.8 trillion. Interest on the debt has totaled nearly $1.2 trillion this year.

meta.note: Gross debt, public debt share, annual deficit, and interest expense measure distinct fiscal coordinates.
